title: Cannabinoid antidotes

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Cannabinoid antidotes are defined as any chemical compound directly associated with the reduction of cannabinoid subjective effects.

This page lists and describes the various cannabinoid antidotes.

Cannabidiol

See also

*Cannabinoids
